AARON'S DECISION (2026-08-11, relayed via Bob): BUILD THE REDACT COMMAND. The one-off raw-SQL sanction is DECLINED — it would fix two rows while leaving the store permanently uncorrectable, and this is the second defect this week blocked by a missing mechanism (the item's own analysis). MOD-032 proves nobody has to be looking for this to happen again. BINDING DESIGN CONSTRAINTS for the build: (1) The forbidden text never transits the command line or the audit trail — no --match argument carrying a real name (shell history and session transcripts exist). The redact command reuses the codename guard's fragment-assembled pattern set to DETECT occurrences itself: 'node claude-bow.js redact <CODE>' scans title/desc, replaces every hit with [REDACTED-GR22], reports only counts and field names. (2) Auditable, never silent: auto-comment on the item recording pattern-class + count + field — NEVER the text; the comment lives in the same DB, quoting the redacted text would recreate the bug one table over. (3) Original text stored nowhere — no backup column, no log line with the pre-image. (4) Also accept --comment <id>: bow_comments is prose-bearing and the obvious next place this leak class lands. AFTER BUILD: run on ASM-150 and MOD-032, then Tester verifies the way Tester-2 verified the guard — payloads through the real contract, not assumed coverage, including a negative control that must pass through untouched (prove the detector can fail). PIPELINE NOTE: root tooling, version-guard-exempt, but GR#22-adjacent — the junior's brief must include the fragment-assembly technique so they never type a real name while writing tests.

go STRUCTURAL — fail-closed deny-by-default, stop enumerating bypass spellings. The r15 REJECT's 8 new spellings (base64 -di, openssl enc -a, env-prefix, gzip/xz -d, xargs sh -c, command-substitution, backslash-newline, PowerShell FromBase64String|iex) prove the denylist is asymptotically incomplete ('a regex is not a shell parser'). Flip the commit-recognition layer to an ALLOWLIST: proceed only on a plain benign git-commit form (git commit, -m/-F/-a/--amend) with zero shell indirection (no pipes/redirection//backticks/env-prefix/wrappers/heredoc/backslash-newline/iex). Anything with an unattributable shell metacharacter -> DENY fail-closed. False-positive deny is recoverable; false-negative allow is the hole.

inc2 Q1 material sourcing (2026-08-31): construction materials come from a LOCAL BUILDERS' MERCHANT (B&Q/Jewsons/builders-merchant firm) if one exists in the city - money stays in-city, merchant profits + is taxed; if NO merchant available, materials are IMPORTED FROM OUTSIDE (external - money leaks out, expect pricier). Builders' merchants AUTO-PLACE when the relevant zone grouping is laid down (reuse the deterministic auto-placement pattern from auto-junctions / orphan road-connect sweep - a merchant is a firm/commercial sub-type that appears on the trigger, deterministic). Flow: build needs materials -> local merchant supply (in-city, taxed) else external import (leak) -> SettleConstruction retargets treasury->firm(merchant) or treasury->external accordingly, conserving. This makes the firms->build edge (proposal 2260ba1) concrete. STILL OPEN for inc2: merchant auto-place TRIGGER (which zone grouping), material granularity (tonnes vs commodity chain), settlement timing - interviewing now.

inc2 (2026-08-31 cont'd): material granularity = GENERIC TONNES (not a commodity chain - simple tonnes of construction material). Settlement timing = TREASURY PAYS ON A BILLING CYCLE (accrue construction costs, settle periodically e.g. monthly, not immediate per-build). Remaining open: merchant auto-place trigger (which zone grouping) - interviewing.

ALL COMMERCIAL PAYMENTS run on a 90-DAY billing cycle (net-90). 1 tick = 1 day so COMMERCIAL_PAYMENT_TERM_TICKS = 90 (named const). This is a finance-wide B2B convention - construction settlement (treasury->builders-merchant) and inter-firm trade settle net-90, accrued then paid at the 90-tick mark. LEAD SCOPE INTERPRETATION (confirming with Aaron): commercial = business-to-business trade (construction->merchant, firm->firm supply); consumer/personal flows (wages to citizens, household consumption spend, council + business TAX collection) stay on their monthly cadence per the money brief - net-90 is trade credit, not payroll/consumer/tax. Applies to inc2 (construction) + any future B2B; inc1's monthly wages/consumption/tax cadence unchanged pending Aaron's confirm.

inc2 merchant trigger (2026-08-31) - inc2 FULLY SPECIFIED: builders' merchants (B&Q/Jewsons-type supplier firms) AUTO-PLACE when an INDUSTRY & FARMS zone grouping is laid down (deterministic auto-placement, reuse the auto-junction/orphan-connect pattern; a merchant is an industrial/trade supplier firm). Build sources GENERIC TONNES of material from a local merchant if one exists (in-city: merchant firm profits + taxed) ELSE imports from outside (external money leak, pricier). Settlement: treasury -> merchant on NET-90 (COMMERCIAL_PAYMENT_TERM_TICKS=90), accrued + settled at the 90-tick mark. Requires the engine.build->engine.firms edge (proposal 2260ba1, registering now). inc2 build gated on: (a) the edge landing, (b) inc1 landing first (shared compose.go). Full inc2 = merchant spec + auto-place + material-source-local-vs-import + net-90 settlement.
